title: Consent scopes enforced on every disclosure write path
notes: The scorer is a thin child-process wrapper (documented in-file, per the plan's own fallback) around a node:test file gated the same way src/lib/rls.test.ts is (RLS_TEST_ENABLED=true + DATABASE_URL), because the guarded functions under test (sendConnection, selectBatchStudents) run through the app's own `prisma` singleton and only become RLS-aware inside withRlsContext + RLS_CONTEXT_INJECTION=true — a real production code path a raw-SQL bootstrap outside node:test cannot exercise. Covers sendConnection (ConsentRecord scope employer_referral), sendPolicySms (NotificationPreference.smsConsentAt — a different consent mechanism for the SMS channel, not literally a ConsentRecord row, but the same kind of scope check), and selectBatchStudents (the WorkForce WV batch export, which must never include a ready-but-unconsented student). All three were already gated in the codebase at measurement time (2026-09-05); this suite makes that gate a durable, falsifiable regression test rather than something only a spec's prose promises.
